record.where: The exile roads (v3.30 — Shutterlight, the guild, the C-series, the Hooded Row)
record.count_text: exileroads.mjs, 22 checks green end to end

clauses.text: reveal gates, journey
exchange arithmetic, restock cycle
guild gating/pay/lapse-free ledger
rank ladder, door, C-series purchases
desk on the table, stone routing
the exiles' sheet voice, save round-trip
Shutterlight is REVEALED, never charted.
No Farkeeper rider will ride toward the exiles; the city arrives because the exiles decide you have seen enough.
The v3.25 rescue (or an exile walker's own coat) MARKS the Darklands table — "a mark nobody made," a hooded lantern charcoaled onto the frame
FOLLOW THE MARK runs a guided journey down a road no survey will hold.
The city opens on the table's far north-west edge with its own pin (a lantern with the shutter half down) and its own desk.
The exchange sells .338 at three metal a round from a cycled stock of six — dear, because the Nomads collect rifles, not brass.

figure.record: three metal a round from a cycled stock of six
figure.note: three rounds cost exactly 9 metal, the stock runs 6 → 3 → 0, and the cycle's turn brings back six, never more

clauses.text: The guild posts the quiet work, gated HONESTLY by what already exists: a rifle on your back (v3.25) and a party of two at it (v3.24).

figure.note: a rifle walking alone (no party) is refused and a rifle with a party of two can work; a party of one is not sampled

clauses.text: Ridge watch, caravan gun, and the quiet collection — which writes the Renegade ledger, because the karma system was always going to color this — run on the wage-law clock with a mid-contract hazard roll
"it went loud" pays half and asks no questions it already knows the answers to

figure.note: the Caravan gun gone loud pays 12 metal and 1 × .338 of its 25 and 2, floored

clauses.text: Contracts done build guild standing: three opens the C3A1 shelf, seven turns THE COLD DOOR's corner of the table.

figure.record: three opens the C3A1 shelf, seven turns THE COLD DOOR's corner
figure.note: standing 1 at 0 and 2 done, 2 at 3 and 6, 3 at 7; the door still hidden at six done and seen at the seventh

clauses.text: guild standing 1→2 (3 done)→3 (7 done)

figure.note: the rank read at 0, 2, 3, 6, 7 and 12 contracts done: 1 1 2 2 3 3

clauses.text: C14 Timberwolf, the hand-me-down; C3A1 at standing two, the red-leaf service bolt; C20 behind the cold door, the semi-automatic answer.

figure.note: refused to a hand of standing 1 with the bank untouched, sold at standing 3 (seven done); standing 2 itself is not sampled

clauses.text: C3A1 at standing 2 (80 metal · 20 ceramic; red leaf in the sights)

figure.note: the bank pays exactly 80 metal and 20 ceramic and nothing else

clauses.text: C20 behind the cold door (120 metal · 24 wood)

figure.note: refused before the knock, then exactly 120 metal and 24 wood

clauses.text: THE COLD DOOR: turns its table corner at standing 3; a KNOCK plays the raised-tongue scene and opens the C20 shelf

figure.note: the door's pin turns at the seventh contract, standing 3, and not at the sixth

clauses.text: Each is a set of multipliers on the v3.25 rifle constants — range, cooldown, drop time, warning radius
A knock at the cold door plays the raised-tongue scene and opens the last shelf

The Lamplighter memorial ground goes LIVE on the v3.29 architecture: revealed with the city, sited far from every station (the exiles bury their own where no map minds), dark stelae under hooded-lantern accents, UNHOODED for a stamp
a Lamplighter-class walker's death routes their stone THERE by the banner on their legacy row, never to the Lantern Rows
and the rifle is NAMED on the pack, the prompt, and the dry-fire line
And the appreciation icon is sized like it matters: 30px beside "+N APPRECIATION" on the waybill, proven on a real local-post delivery.

figure.note: a real local-post delivery (a letter run off Elm Farm's board, handed over at Haven on a real E) lands a waybill whose icon beside "+N APPRECIATION" renders 30×30

clauses.text: The appreciation icon sized like it matters: 30px on the waybill's "+N APPRECIATION" line, 16–18px in the ledgers — proven on a real local-post delivery

figure.note: 30×30 on the waybill; on the terminal the icon under the stars renders 16 and each rung of the Mail tab's appreciation ladder 18

design.what: the plain names: the Darklands table is the Map's Region view (the Region map); the mark and the city's pin stand on it
